metadata.description: Claude Code mods for developing SteamHangar: token metering, read brakes, output trimming and zero-token commands (generic; host paths come in as plugin options).

plugins.name: token-meter
plugins.description: Logs token counts per model request and agent to a JSONL file; /tokens prints a zero-token summary.

plugins.name: read-brake
plugins.description: Denies whole-file reads of large planning docs and very large files; asks for grep plus a line range instead.

plugins.name: output-trim
plugins.description: Trims long Bash output to head, tail and failure lines; keeps the full output in a file.
